items.full: I believe clear communication is more important than technical skills for a successful team leader. The main reason is that a leader needs to make sure everyone understands the same goals and priorities. For example, when our team prepared a company event, two departments had different expectations about the schedule. Our team leader arranged a short meeting, clarified each person's responsibilities, and shared a revised timeline. As a result, we avoided confusion and completed the event on time. Technical knowledge is certainly helpful, but a leader can also ask specialists for advice. In my view, communication skills help the entire team work effectively.
